name: shironigun
description: AI tools marketplace by shironigun — skills, plugins, and MCP servers for AI-assisted workflows

plugins.name: qa-toolkit
plugins.description: QA workflow automation — generate API and UI test cases, convert failures to bugs, push to your tracker

plugins.name: bug-suite
plugins.description: File story and regression Bugs, production Defects and ticket comments in Azure DevOps in a QA house style; your boards and fields are discovered into a local profile

plugins.name: release-notes-suite
plugins.description: Two-stage release pipeline: harvester builds the complete engineering inventory; releaser writes short, benefit-led client release notes, one variant per brand

plugins.name: ui-testing
plugins.description: UI test case authoring and Playwright script generation: buggy (Azure DevOps Test Cases) and tester (cases + runnable UI specs)

plugins.name: api-testing
plugins.description: API test case authoring, Playwright + TypeScript script generation, and bug drafting — api-tester (cases + specs) and api-bugger (triage + bug draft)

plugins.name: qa-engineering
plugins.description: AI QA engineering — one orchestrator for the whole QA loop: analyze an ADO story, author + approve test cases, publish them to a Test Plan/Suite, build + generate API + UI automation, and turn a failing run into a filed bug, human-gated at every tracker write. Also teaches and reviews a self-contained, product-neutral Playwright + TypeScript framework; the QA's specifics live in a git-ignored house-profile

plugins.name: feature-explainer
plugins.description: Name a feature and a reader (product, QA, design, dev, sales) and get a visual explainer page for them: researched read-only, drawn as journeys, grids and annotated screens, the right detail collapsed or left out

plugins.name: how-to-guides
plugins.description: Customer how-to guides for any B2B software: one feature, researched read-only, written to a standard and built as a branded PDF. Your brand and house rules stay in your own howto-brand.json
